hypothesis: Among seven non-USD currencies, a medium-term cross-sectional momentum portfolio that is long the two strongest currencies versus USD and short the two weakest, rebalanced weekly after a fixed quote-resolution delay, may retain net momentum after executable BID/ASK and holding costs.
selection_rule: Select horizon only by discovery mean weekly net R under primary costs; tie-break by larger Holm-adjusted four-week block-bootstrap lower bound, then lower drawdown. Freeze selected horizon and score unchanged confirmation; do not switch horizons after seeing confirmation.
cost_model: Side-correct observed BID/ASK entry/exit; $10 round-trip commission per standard 100,000-unit lot; +1 pip per round-trip adverse slippage primary; +2 pip-equivalent adverse swap proxy per 7-day hold primary. Stress: +2 pips slippage and +4 pip-equivalent swap per week. Swap is a proxy, not verified account terms.
falsification_gates: Candidate-specific V2 source, timestamp, coverage, exact-join and active-quote preflight passes before any outcome compute.
For each horizon: at least 200 eligible discovery position legs / 100 dates and 100 confirmation legs / 70 dates.
At primary cost, discovery and confirmation each require net R > 0 and PF_R >= 1.05; under stress each requires net R > 0 and PF_R >= 1.00.
At least 2 of complete discovery years 2018-2020 positive, and no one year contributes more than 70% of positive discovery net R.
10,000 replicate, four-week circular block bootstrap with zero-trade weeks included and seed 330; lower 95% bounds >0 in discovery and confirmation; Holm correction across three discovery horizons.
note: New causal construction relative to R323: 5-session strength was tested as same-day continuation and stopped at a sample gate; R330 uses 13/26/39-week cross-sectional ranking and weekly portfolio holding, not time-series sign-per-pair as in R329. Historical years remain contaminated and cannot establish promotion-level OOS. H1 provides a one-hour bar-open fill proxy, not exact five-minute fill.
